title: The Gates Scholarship
award: Last-dollar funding for the full cost of attendance
summary: Highly selective scholarship for outstanding high school seniors from low-income households.
eligibility: Pell-eligible high school seniors who meet citizenship, GPA, enrollment and identity requirements listed by the program.

title: Cooke College Scholarship Program
summary: Renewable undergraduate scholarship for high-achieving high school seniors with financial need.
eligibility: U.S. high school seniors planning full-time enrollment at an accredited four-year college who meet GPA and financial-need requirements.

title: Hagan Scholarship
award: Up to $7,500 per semester plus additional benefits
summary: Nationwide need-based merit scholarship designed to help recipients graduate college debt-free.
eligibility: Graduating U.S. high school students meeting the program's GPA, household-income, employment and college-enrollment requirements.

title: Cameron Impact Scholarship
award: Four-year full tuition and qualified educational expenses
summary: Impact-driven scholarship for exceptional student leaders pursuing any academic area at a U.S. college.
eligibility: Class of 2028 students who are U.S. citizens, have at least a 3.7 unweighted GPA and demonstrate leadership and community service.

title: Burger King Scholars Program
summary: Scholarships for high school seniors and eligible Burger King employees and family members.
eligibility: Eligibility varies by award and includes graduating high school seniors plus qualifying Burger King employees and their families.

title: Elks Most Valuable Student Scholarship
summary: National competition for high school seniors judged on scholarship, leadership and financial need.
eligibility: U.S. citizen high school seniors planning full-time study toward a four-year degree at a U.S. college or university.

title: Horatio Alger Undergraduate Scholarships
summary: A collection of national and state scholarships for students who have overcome significant adversity.
eligibility: Requirements vary; programs generally consider financial need, perseverance, integrity, academics and community involvement.

title: GE-Reagan Foundation Scholarship Program
provider: Ronald Reagan Presidential Foundation and Institute
summary: Renewable national scholarship recognizing leadership, drive, integrity and citizenship.
eligibility: High school seniors nationwide who satisfy the program's citizenship, enrollment, academic and leadership requirements.

title: Live Más Scholarship
summary: Passion-based scholarship supporting young people pursuing higher education and workforce preparation.
eligibility: Eligible U.S. residents ages 16–26 pursuing an educational program and using their passion to create positive change.

title: Jackie Robinson Foundation Scholarship
summary: Four-year scholarship and mentoring program for academically accomplished student leaders with financial need.
eligibility: Graduating U.S. high school seniors demonstrating financial need, academic excellence, leadership and community service.

title: HSF Scholar Program
award: Scholar support services and competitive financial awards
summary: National scholar-support program with financial awards available to selected eligible scholars.
eligibility: Students of Hispanic heritage who meet citizenship or residency, GPA, enrollment and financial-aid application requirements.

title: APIA Scholars Scholarship Program
summary: Scholarships supporting Asian American, Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander undergraduate students.
eligibility: Eligible citizens, nationals and permanent residents entering or continuing an undergraduate degree at an accredited U.S. institution.

title: Point Foundation Flagship Scholarship
award: Need-based financial award renewable for up to four years
summary: Financial support, leadership development and community resources for LGBTQ+ and ally students.
eligibility: Students connected and committed to the LGBTQ+ and ally community who meet GPA and full-time enrollment requirements.

title: Tillman Scholar Program
award: Academic scholarship, leadership development and national network
summary: Merit-based academic fellowship for military members, veterans and spouses committed to service and leadership.
eligibility: Veterans, active-duty service members and current or surviving military spouses enrolled full-time in an eligible degree program.

title: American Legion Legacy Scholarship
award: Up to $20,000 for children of the fallen; up to $5,000 for children of disabled veterans
summary: Needs-based scholarship for eligible children of post-9/11 fallen and disabled U.S. service members.
eligibility: Children of qualifying fallen service members or post-9/11 veterans with a combined VA disability rating of 50% or higher.

title: Scholarship America Dream Award
summary: Renewable scholarship designed to help students continue and complete an undergraduate or technical degree.
eligibility: Students enrolled or planning to enroll in eligible higher-education programs who demonstrate financial need and meet program requirements.

title: Benjamin A. Gilman International Scholarship
award: Up to $5,000 plus possible supplemental awards
summary: Federal scholarship helping undergraduate Pell Grant recipients study or intern abroad.
eligibility: U.S. undergraduate students receiving a Federal Pell Grant and participating in an eligible credit-bearing study-abroad or internship program.

title: Dell Scholars Program
award: Financial assistance, academic coaching and career support
summary: College-completion scholarship combining flexible financial support with academic and professional resources.
eligibility: High school seniors in an approved college-readiness program who are Pell-eligible, have at least a 2.4 GPA and plan full-time four-year enrollment.
